digest.component_or_area: pai_structured output recovery and retry mechanism
propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with one bounded Pydantic Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter, preserving full input and stored response history

Wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor omits failed ModelResponse from retry wire only when response tokens plus effective_max_tokens fit the model window for every candidate; omits response WHOLE when it does not fit while all_messages() retains full history
Authoritative-input overflow (input_tokens + effective_max_tokens exceeding window) raises ContextWindowExceededError without shortening content, never partially

On PROMPTED branch only, a new concision-aware guard detects truncation via finish_reason or provider_details and sends in-run ModelRetry before parsing; delegates non-truncation cases to existing S1 logic; NativeOutput branch keeps pai_output.guard_capability() terminal

One shared request budget computed once (base + output-retry allowance) with no per-attempt reset; output-retry counter shared by concision guard and TextOutput validator, exhaustion raises UnexpectedModelBehavior translated to UnretryableOutputError

NativeOutput mode unchanged: selects via output_mode, runs under shared bounded operation with pai_output.guard_capability(), keeps truncation terminal, preserves bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback to prompted path
